lessons.title: Words the C64 has already claimed

exercises.title: Type and predict
exercises.text: Put the points you scored in two rounds of a game into two variables. Before printing their total, write down what it will be.

exercises.title: Fix it
exercises.text: These commands don't work. Find both problems, explain each in one sentence, and fix them: ARMOR = 30, then ENDURANCE = ARMOR * 2.

exercises.title: Build it
exercises.text: Use three variables: the name of a place in a game you like, how many treasures are hidden there, and the name of the best treasure. Make the C64 print one sentence about it, mixing words and boxes the way Lesson 1.2 shows. Add all three to your variable dictionary first, with their data types.

quiz.question: After X = 4 and then X = X * 5, what does PRINT X show?
After G% = 9.99, what does PRINT G% show?
Which variable can hold the words GOOD JOB?
Which of these names is always safe?
A program uses MAGIC and MANA. What goes wrong?

lessons.title: Fixing a line on the screen

exercises.title: Predict the order
exercises.text: Type NEW, then these lines in this order: 30 PRINT "BLUE", 10 PRINT "RED", 40 PRINT "VIOLET", 20 PRINT "GREEN". Before typing LIST and RUN, write down what each will show.

exercises.title: Fix it two ways
exercises.text: Type the TODAY'S TARGET program from Lesson 2.4. Fix line 20 once by retyping the whole line, then break it again and fix it with the screen editor. Which way was faster?

exercises.title: Build it
exercises.text: Plan a short "game over" screen on paper: a title, your final score, and a message, one per line, using variables from your variable dictionary. Number the lines by tens, type it, and run it. Then add a new line between the score and the message *without* retyping anything else.

quiz.question: You type 20 PRINT "SAVED" and press RETURN. What happens?

options.text: The line is stored and nothing is printed

quiz.question: You type lines 60, then 30, then 50. What does LIST show first?
What does typing 30 by itself and pressing RETURN do?

options.text: It leaves room to add lines in between

quiz.question: Which command shows only lines 20 through 40?
